personal_information.headline: PhD Researcher | HPC & AI Engineer | Scientific Computing

professional_summary: Researcher specializing in turning complex research into real-world products. Background across physics, mathematics, and computer science, building scalable platforms with HPC, Big Data, and AI. Architecting distributed systems and parallel workflows for high-throughput research and enterprise workloads. Translating academic research into production systems, roadmaps, and stakeholder value with expertise in physics-informed AI for trustworthy, explainable, and robust predictions.

work_experience.employer: Istituto Nazionale di Oceanografia e di Geofisica Sperimentale (OGS) & Università degli Studi di Trieste (UniTS)
responsibilities_and_achievements: Developed automated seismic data processing pipelines on HPC clusters using SLURM, MPI, and GPU parallelization.
Implemented ML-based earthquake detection workflows integrating SeisBench, PyOcto, and NonLinLoc.
Created dynamic job submission systems that allocated workloads across compute nodes with 32+ cores/node.
Designed reproducible scientific workflows using GNU Make and Hydra configuration frameworks.
Achieved 94% detection accuracy on production seismic workloads across Italy's northeastern national seismic network.

work_experience.employer: ORACLE de México, SA de CV
responsibilities_and_achievements: Architected and deployed a production backend for automated analytics through a customer-facing API.
Engineered automated patch recommendation workflows to streamline customer-facing diagnostic analysis.
Mentored junior developers and established code review practices.
Developed thermal-process simulations for Multi Jet Fusion 3D printing technology.
Validated computational models against experimental materials-science benchmarks.
Conducted computational physics research on complex systems and statistical mechanics.
Developed Monte Carlo simulations for phase transition analysis in social dynamics models.

education.description: Built distributed training/inference pipelines across multi-node GPU clusters (MPI/CUDA) for large seismic datasets; engineered a custom validation framework using bipartite optimization and weighted similarity scoring.

education.institution: Scuola Internazionale Superiore di Studi Avanzati (SISSA)
education.description: Developed an end-to-end ML pipeline for real-time earthquake detection; architected HPC-optimized workflows with Transformers and CNNs to ingest continuous data streams at scale.

Studied Approximate Message Passing (AMP) for rank-one estimation in the spiked Wigner model; developed and evaluated a prior-independent scheduler for the Onsager correction term. Applied the method to unstructured and structured random-matrix noise, reproducing Bayes-optimal behavior in the standard model and identifying limitations for structured noise.

Simulated complex social systems with 1D Ising spin models integrating Kawasaki and Schelling dynamics; quantified critical exponents via finite-size scaling (z approximately 2.48, lambda approximately 1.15, theta approximately 0.46).

education.institution: Instituto Tecnológico y de Estudios Superiores de Occidente (ITESO)

projects.name: Automated Seismic Data Processing Pipeline
projects.description: End-to-end HPC pipeline for seismic event detection: waveform acquisition, ML-based phase picking (SeisBench), octree-based association (PyOcto), and 3D hypocenter location (NonLinLoc). Dynamic SLURM job generation with template-based configuration and GNU Make orchestration.

projects.name: Event Matching & Validation Framework
projects.description: Novel validation system using Hungarian algorithm-based bipartite optimization with custom weighted similarity metrics (location, magnitude, origin time). Enables rigorous comparison against authoritative catalogs (INGV). Open-source contribution for reproducible seismology research.

projects.name: Additive Manufacturing Thermal Simulator
projects.description: High-fidelity finite element simulation of powder bed fusion processes. Validated against experimental thermal imaging data from HP's Multi Jet Fusion production line.

projects.name: Social Dynamics Simulation Engine
projects.description: Monte Carlo framework for studying segregation and opinion dynamics in complex networks. Implemented Ising-based models with Kawasaki-Schelling hybrid dynamics. Characterized critical exponents via finite-size scaling.
